note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the soldier is recorded as unknown, so that section is not given; the short diameter of the ocellus is damaged in the scan and is not recorded; the synonymy list, figure references, distribution records and discussion of tibial spurs are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: total length with wings 15.0-16.0, length without wings 9.0-10.0; head subcircular; mid-dorsal spot large, circular and shining; antennae 15-segmented. Worker: total length 4.30-6.00; antennae 14-segmented. Soldier recorded as unknown in the original description.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule shining brown to dark brown; postclypeus generally paler than head; antennae and legs yellowish white; abdomen brown dorsally, white ventrally; head and body rather densely pilose; total length 4.30-6.00. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandible base 0.90-1.20, maximum width 1.20-1.40); Y-shaped suture present; mid-dorsal spot translucent white, shining, circular (diameter 0.12-0.16), at the junction of the Y-shaped suture, very weakly raised. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 long and clavate, longer than segment 2 or 4. Postclypeus raised and pilose, about half as long as wide or slightly more than half. Labrum dome-shaped, pilose near the apex and on the body, wider than long. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.40-0.50, maximum width 0.65-0.80), anterior margin rounded. Legs long and slender, tibial spur formula 3:2:2.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark chestnut brown; postclypeus slightly paler than head; antennae and tarsi pale straw yellow; thorax and abdomen dorsally almost as dark as head or slightly paler; sternites brown; head and body densely covered with short microtrichia, interspersed with a few long setae. Total length with wings 15.0-16.0, without wings 9.0-10.0. Head subcircular (length to mandible base 0.88-1.20, maximum width 1.35-1.52). Mid-dorsal spot large, circular (diameter 0.25), shining and translucent, situated medially; Y-shaped suture absent. Eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.35-0.40). Ocelli small, suboval, translucent, separated from the eye by about their short diameter (long diameter 0.13-0.16, eye-ocellus distance 0.09-0.10). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus strongly raised and pilose, longitudinally divided into two halves medially, about half as long as wide. Anteclypeus translucent white, glabrous, anterior margin produced medially. Labrum dome-shaped, with a few setae anteriorly and on the body (length 0.45, width 0.50). Pronotum subrectangular, sides rounded, slightly narrower than head including eyes (length 0.75-0.80, width 1.19-1.30); anterior margin weakly emarginate with a weak median impression, posterior margin nearly straight and weakly emarginate medially; posterior margins of meso- and metanotum sharply emarginate. Legs short and slender, pilose, tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Wings dirty brown, margins pilose; fore wing with wing scales 13.55 long, hind wing 12.65; fore wing without scales 12.8, hind wing 12.0; membrane with a fine, weak vein network.
